title: Detailed bell
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Bell body - main dome -->
  <path d='M50 12
    C50 12, 30 20, 28 50
    L28 60
    Q28 64, 24 66
    L76 66
    Q72 64, 72 60
    L72 50
    C70 20, 50 12, 50 12Z'
    fill='#E8B830' stroke='#F5D060' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  
  <!-- Bell body highlight -->
  <path d='M50 16
    C50 16, 36 24, 34 48
    L34 58
    Q34 60, 32 62
    L40 62
    Q38 60, 38 58
    L38 48
    C40 26, 50 18, 50 18Z'
    fill='#F8E070' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Bell body shading right side -->
  <path d='M50 16
    C50 16, 62 24, 64 48
    L64 58
    Q64 60, 66 62
    L60 62
    Q62 60, 62 58
    L62 48
    C60 26, 50 18, 50 18Z'
    fill='#C89820' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Rim band - wider bottom edge -->
  <path d='M24 66
    L76 66
    L78 72
    Q78 74, 74 74
    L26 74
    Q22 74, 22 72
    Z'
    fill='#D4A020' stroke='#F5D060' stroke-width='1'/>
  
  <!-- Rim band highlight -->
  <path d='M24 66 L50 66 L50 74 L26 74 Q22 74, 22 72 Z'
    fill='#F0C840' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Decorative band above rim -->
  <rect x='28' y='58' width='44' height='4' rx='2'
    fill='#F5D060'/>
  
  <!-- Decorative dots on band -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='60' r='1.5' fill='#B08010'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='60' r='1.5' fill='#B08010'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='1.5' fill='#B08010'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='60' r='1.5' fill='#B08010'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='60' r='1.5' fill='#B08010'/>
  
  <!-- Decorative middle band -->
  <path d='M30 40 Q50 36, 70 40 L70 44 Q50 40, 30 44 Z'
    fill='#D4A020'/>
  
  <!-- Middle band highlight -->
  <path d='M30 40 Q50 36, 70 40 L70 41 Q50 37, 30 41 Z'
    fill='#F0C840' opacity='0.7'/>
  
  <!-- Bell top handle/loop -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='10' r='5' fill='none' stroke='#D4A020' stroke-width='3'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='10' r='5' fill='none' stroke='#F5D060' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Bell clapper visible at bottom -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#C89820' stroke='#F5D060' stroke-width='1'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='77' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#F0C840'/>
  
  <!-- Clapper ball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='82' r='4' fill='#D4A020'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='80' r='1.5' fill='#F8E070' opacity='0.7'/>
  
  <!-- Small sparkles/stars decoration -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#FFF8C0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='35' r='1' fill='#FFF8C0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='50' r='1' fill='#FFF8C0' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='52' r='1.5' fill='#FFF8C0' opacity='0.7'/>
  
  <!-- Top shine spot -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='28' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#FFFCE0' opacity='0.5' transform='rotate(-15 44 28)'/>
</svg>
